title: The unit circle and angles of any magnitude

sections.heading: Core Concepts: The unit circle and angles of any magnitude

questions.q: In $\triangle ABC$ studying the unit circle and angles of any magnitude, $m\angle A = 37^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$?
questions.answer: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (37^\circ + 45^\circ) = 98^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $6\text{ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length?
questions.answer: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $6 \times 2 = 12\text{ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 2$ passes through $(0, 7)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$?
